cause: Linux automatic client ports overlap this assigned listener range. The fixed-count probe used 48832 as a client source port to 48820, leaving non-reusable TIME-WAIT.
effect: Guard bind failed before starting every affected gate; these exits are NOT RUN and not credited as negative controls.
resolution: Hold bound-only SO_REUSEADDR/SO_REUSEPORT reservations on 48840-48842 across the entire remaining serial gate matrix. No sysctl or listener behavior changed.
